findings.title: Both bound physical GPUs are occupied above the declared per-device bound at review time
findings.detail: Live nvidia-smi at review shows physical GPU 6 at 28167 MiB and physical GPU 7 at 34755 MiB, both above the manifest's max_gpu_occupancy_bytes of 21474836480 (20 GiB). The packet disclosed GPU 7 at 23,491 MiB and GPU 6 drained (3 MiB) at freeze; GPU 6 has since acquired external shared-host load. The UUID-to-physical-index binding is unchanged and correct. Occupancy is an execution-time gate, not a freeze defect: the executor revalidates the map, per-device occupancy, and disk before marker creation and again before the first GPU command, and the packet declares itself not executable until both devices are within the bound. The lead MUST independently confirm both devices are within the bound immediately before invoking execute; this READY verdict does not assert that they are.

superseded_receipt.reason: The withdrawn receipt reached the same READY verdict on the same recomputed evidence, but its verified_bindings.manifest_whitelist_diff_vs_attempt_7.changed_leaves_by_category split was hand-tallied and wrong: it recorded 26 r7-to-r8 path substitutions and 7 attempt-7-to-attempt-8 receipt-name substitutions where the mechanical tally is 27 and 6 (the packet_author_identity leaf was double-counted into the receipt-name bucket). The load-bearing claims were correct and unchanged in both receipts: 306 leaves on both sides, zero keys added or removed, 47 changed leaves, and zero changed leaves outside the whitelist. The withdrawn receipt also asserted all_pins_match_tasks_md_3_4 without having individually recomputed the Attempt-3/4/5/6 manifest and packet pins; those eight digests have now been recomputed and all match. A signed receipt must not carry an unverified or incorrect stated fact at any status, so it was replaced in place by the same reviewer before any consumer read it: the executor's _pre_marker_validate is the only consumer and it was never invoked, and the only other open was this reviewer's own self-test. Exactly one immutable receipt exists at the authorized path.
